units: <cite ref="Berakhot 17a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ערום בי׳</he> cautious in religious affairs.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:7:1">Koh. R. to IX, 7</cite> <he>שתהא יִרְאָתְךָ וכ׳</he>, v. preced.—<he>עשה מִיִּ׳</he> (or <cite ref="P00014"><he>עבד</he></cite>) to do good (to worship) from motives of fear, opp. <he>מאהבה</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:5:4">Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>פרוש י׳</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01738"><he>פָּרוּשׁ</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>יִרְאַת שמים</he> fear of the Lord; <he>יִרְאַת חטא</he> fear of sin (v. <cite ref="J00591">preced.</cite>).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:11">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>הוציאה יִרְאָתָהּ וכ׳</he> she took her idol out of her bosom. Pesik. Vayhi. p. 65ᵇ; Mekh. Bo. s. 13 <he>יִרְאָתֵנוּ</he> our (Egyptian) deity; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יִרְאוֹת</he>. Ib. B’shall., Vayhi, s. 1; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 230:8">Yalk. Ex. 230</cite> <he>מכל הי׳ שלהם</he> of all their (the Egyptians’) gods.
